lines: - The nervous system is divided into two main parts:
- includes all the nerves that branch out from the brain and spinal cord
- The nervous system is structurally organized into:
(1) Grey matter: consists mainly of neuronal cell bodies.
(2) White matter: is composed of myelinated axons
- Nucleus: refers to a collection of neuronal cell bodies located within CNS
- Ganglion: refers to a collection of neuronal cell bodies located outside the CNS

Functional Organization of the Cerebral Cortex: Sensory Areas

Somatosensory association area - posterior to primary somatosensory area.

Prefrontal cortex - anterior portion of the frontal lobe.
